description: This file defines the DeviceSpecific interface for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifying methods for device-specific functionalities such as gesture detection, input correction, input method reporting, clipboard creation, and vibration handling.

classes.name: DeviceSpecific
classes.description: Interface defining device-specific functionalities for the keyboard application.

methods.name: getApiLevel
methods.description: Returns the API level of the device as a string.

methods.name: createGestureDetector
methods.description: Creates a GestureDetector with the provided context and listener.

methods.name: commitCorrectionToInputConnection
methods.description: Commits a correction to the input connection, replacing an old word with a new one at a specified offset.

methods.name: reportInputMethodSubtypes
methods.description: Reports available input method subtypes to the system.

methods.name: reportCurrentInputMethodSubtypes
methods.description: Reports the current input method subtypes to the system.

methods.name: createPressVibrator
methods.description: Creates a device-specific press vibrator object.
